Benchmark the New Zealand key against the National Soils Database

Source: R/nsd.R
benchmark_nsd.Rd

Classifies NSD pedons (read_nsd_pedons) with classify_nzsc4 and compares the result with the surveyor's NZSC class at the level asked: the order (the first letter of the code), the group (the first two letters) or the subgroup (the whole code). A pedon is compared at a level only when its recorded class reaches that level (a code of one letter names only the order). A result is provisional when a class before the assigned one at the level asked, or a level above it, could not be decided ($provisional_because of classify_nzsc4); accuracy_decided counts only the results that are not provisional.

Usage

benchmark_nsd(
  pedons,
  level = c("order", "group", "subgroup"),
  cores = 1L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

pedons

A list of PedonRecords from read_nsd_pedons.

level

"order", "group" or "subgroup".

cores

Number of processes (parallel::mclapply; always 1 on Windows).

verbose

Print a summary.

Value

A list: level; accuracy; accuracy_decided; n_compared; n_decided; confusion (reference by prediction, codes); per_class_recall; predictions (one row per pedon with a reference: the recorded and predicted codes at every level, agree, provisional and provisional_because).
